OCR Scanner – PDF & Text

Privacy Policy

How local documents, optional cloud uploads, sign-in, purchases, ads and this website work.

Effective 9 October 2026Version 1.4.0 · Optional cloud OCR
Policy scopeLocal documents and on-device recognitionOnline services and sharingOptional Datalab cloud OCROptional Pro purchaseAds and privacy choicesApp configurationLocal advertising limitsStorage and retentionExports and supportWebsite and hostingYour choices and requestsChanges to this policyFrench and Arabic summaries

Policy scope

This policy describes OCR Scanner – PDF & Text, the Android application with package com.chandra.ocr.offline, and its companion product website. Version 1.4.0 adds an optional Datalab cloud OCR engine alongside the existing on-device engine. Cloud OCR is unavailable until server processing and Google sign-in are configured. This policy explains the data handling when that service is available; it does not state that provider setup or a cloud account connection has already succeeded.

Advertising remains controlled by the app configuration. Version 1.4.0 ships with test and commercial ads disabled. A later authorized configuration may change the mode after required privacy setup. Confirmed Pro access suppresses ads.

The independent publisher of OCR Scanner can be reached at chennoufo11@gmail.com for privacy and support questions.

Local documents and on-device recognition

You select image or PDF files, or capture a page with a camera application. The app copies normalized page images into its private device storage and saves document titles, dates, page adjustments, engine choices, favorites and recognized text locally. Local history remains on the device with either OCR engine.

The on-device engine recognizes English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese and Turkish using the bundled Google ML Kit Latin model. Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean use bundled Tesseract language models. On-device recognition does not require an account, model download or internet connection. Its language selector is independent of the interface language.

On-device recognition does not upload the selected pages or recognized text to the publisher, Google, Datalab or another OCR service. Selecting Datalab cloud OCR changes this handling only after you confirm the document upload. A cloud failure does not silently switch to the on-device engine.

Online services and sharing

The app uses internet access for optional Datalab OCR, Google sign-in for that service, Samsung purchases, Google advertising and privacy messages, and downloading its public configuration. On-device recognition continues to work offline. The services process the connection and service information described below.

Document titles, images, recognized text and OCR language choices are not sent as ad targeting information or as part of Samsung purchase requests. There is no separate publisher analytics SDK. Cloud recognition receives only the document data needed for its job; local-only documents are not uploaded.

Android, camera apps, file providers and applications you choose to use have their own privacy practices. Permissions and access you grant to these services are controlled by your device and those services.

Optional Datalab cloud OCR

Cloud OCR requires internet access and Google sign-in. Before recognition starts, the app asks whether to upload the prepared pages of that document. If you confirm, those page images are sent over HTTPS to the publisher’s Cloudflare-hosted backend and forwarded to the authenticated Datalab API for OCR. This app does not use Datalab’s public Playground. Datalab detects document languages automatically. Uploads and status checks can continue in the background for the confirmed job.

Cloudflare processes the uploaded content, job status, results and ordinary connection information to host and protect this service. Datalab receives the prepared page content for recognition and returns text, formatting and any supported extracted content. The backend uses a generic page filename and does not need your local document title for the provider request. See Cloudflare’s Privacy Policy, Datalab’s Privacy Policy and Datalab’s service agreement. Provider-side retention and use of submitted content follow the applicable service agreement and provider controls. We do not promise a fixed Datalab deletion period or describe the publisher’s 24-hour server expiry as a provider deletion guarantee.

Google sign-in supplies an ID token to authenticate cloud requests. The backend verifies the token and uses a hashed account identifier to separate jobs and enforce usage limits. Job records include that identifier, document and job identifiers, page counts, creation and expiry times, processing status and file fingerprints. The backend does not store your Google password, and it does not send the Google ID token or account identifier to Datalab. Google processes sign-in information under its Privacy Policy.

Our server content expires 24 hours after job creation and becomes unavailable through the service at expiry. Input copies may be removed sooner after successful processing. Physical cleanup is scheduled and may be delayed or retried; expiry is not a promise that every storage copy is physically deleted at exactly 24 hours. Minimal job records used for quotas and duplicate-request protection are scheduled for removal 48 hours after content expiry. Provider infrastructure and security records follow the providers’ own policies.

Deleting a document from this device removes its local history and pages and stops local processing. It does not by itself guarantee immediate deletion of cloud or provider copies. Our server copies follow the expiry and scheduled cleanup above; Datalab retains data according to its own policy and applicable agreement. Signing out prevents future authenticated requests but does not erase previously uploaded content.

Optional Pro purchase

OCR Scanner Pro is an optional one-time purchase processed through Galaxy Store using Samsung IAP. Product prices, payment, ownership checks and restore requests are handled by Samsung. A Samsung account and internet connection are needed for purchase or restore. We do not receive or store your payment card details.

The SDK receives product details and purchase/ownership identifiers and uses them to unlock Pro and acknowledge delivery to Samsung. It may process account, device, network and transaction information under Samsung’s privacy policy. Document images and recognized text are not included in these purchase requests.

The app stores a device-bound, authenticated Pro entitlement locally, so previously confirmed Pro access can continue offline. Successful ownership checks update this entitlement, including removing it when the store reports no purchase. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes the local cache; use Restore purchases with the same Samsung account to recover eligible purchases.

Ads and privacy choices

From version 1.2.0, Free can display Google AdMob ads. Version 1.2.1 and later support configuration-controlled test or commercial advertising. Version 1.4.0 ships with both modes disabled. Test ads still contact Google; they are not an offline simulation. The data handling below applies to either advertising mode. Confirmed Pro access suppresses ads and ad loading.

Google’s advertising SDK collects and shares IP addresses (which can indicate approximate location), ad/app interactions, diagnostics, and device or account identifiers such as the advertising ID and app set ID. Google uses this information for advertising, measurement and fraud prevention. Requests are encrypted in transit. See Google’s SDK data disclosure and Google’s Privacy Policy.

Google’s privacy message manages applicable choices before ad requests are allowed. Where required, Ad privacy choices in Settings lets you review or change your choices. Choices are stored by the consent service on your device. Basic document recognition remains available if ads cannot be requested. Changing a choice affects future requests; it does not erase information already received by Google.

You can also reset or delete your advertising ID through your device’s advertising settings. Google’s own privacy controls and policy govern access, deletion and retention of information it holds.

App configuration

The app downloads a small public configuration file over HTTPS from raw.githubusercontent.com to control whether ads are enabled, their test or commercial mode, placements and frequency. This request includes normal connection information such as your IP address and HTTP request metadata. It does not include documents, recognized text or purchase receipts. GitHub processes hosting information under its Privacy Statement.

The app keeps a local configuration cache and timing preferences in private device storage. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes these local values. A remote configuration does not upload documents or change your Pro ownership or privacy choices.

Local advertising limits

The app stores full-screen ad display counts and a last-recorded UTC day in private device storage to limit advertising frequency. Session counts last for the current app process; daily counts survive app restarts and changes to language or configuration. These local limits are not sent in configuration requests. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes them.

Storage and retention

Local documents, page images and results remain in private device storage until you delete them, clear the app’s data or uninstall it. Android backup of app data is disabled. Android app sandboxing protects stored files; this app does not add separate database encryption. Purchase entitlement, engine and language choices, app configuration and privacy preferences are also held locally.

The Delete document action stops local processing and removes the saved pages, local OCR job files and document database entry. Deleting an individual draft page removes that saved page. Temporary capture or processing files may remain after an interrupted operation until document deletion or app storage is cleared. Downloaded cloud results remain in local history until you delete them.

Cloud content and minimal job records follow the separate expiry and cleanup periods stated above. Google, Samsung, GitHub, Cloudflare and Datalab determine retention of information received by their services under their policies and applicable agreements. Clearing app storage, uninstalling, signing out or deleting local documents does not delete records held by those providers.

Exports and support

Sharing and exports happen only when you initiate them through Android’s chooser or file picker. The destination you select receives that content. Exported and shared copies are outside the app and are not deleted when you remove the original document.

If you email chennoufo11@gmail.com, we receive the information and attachments you choose to send and use them to respond to your request. Avoid sending confidential documents. We do not need your scan content to answer ordinary app questions. Your email service and our email provider also process those messages under their own policies. Support correspondence is retained only for responding and any applicable recordkeeping requirements; ask us to delete it when no longer needed.

Website and hosting

This website does not ask you to upload documents, create an app account or provide payment information. We have not added advertising trackers, analytics scripts, contact forms or third-party media embeds. Fonts, screenshots and other page assets are served with the website.

The website’s hosting and security providers, including GitHub Pages and its infrastructure, may process normal connection information such as your IP address, request metadata and browser details for delivery, abuse prevention and security. Provider-managed cookies or access controls may be used by that infrastructure. Their policies govern their own processing. Reading the bundled privacy policy inside the app does not contact this website.

Your choices and requests

You can choose on-device recognition to avoid document uploads, decline a cloud upload, sign out of the cloud service, and view, share or delete local documents. You can also clear app storage through Android Settings or uninstall the app. The publisher cannot recover offline documents deleted from your device.

Contact chennoufo11@gmail.com for questions or requests about cloud job data handled by the publisher or information you sent us directly. Do not include confidential document content in an ordinary support request. For information held by Google, Samsung, GitHub, Cloudflare or Datalab, the relevant provider’s controls and applicable agreement also apply. Depending on where you live, privacy law may provide rights to access, correct or delete personal information. We will respond in accordance with applicable requirements.

This app does not request children’s personal information. If a child sends personal information to support, a parent or guardian may contact us to request its removal.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the app, cloud service or website changes. The effective date will be updated. Material changes to data handling will be described in release information and the current policy. Advertising mode changes remain subject to required privacy choices and Pro ad suppression.

Résumé en français

La version 1.4.0 conserve la reconnaissance sur l’appareil, sans compte ni Internet, et ajoute un mode Datalab cloud facultatif. Le cloud nécessite Internet, une connexion Google et votre confirmation avant l’envoi des pages à notre serveur Cloudflare puis à Datalab. Le service reste indisponible tant que sa configuration n’est pas terminée. L’historique reste local. Le contenu de notre serveur expire 24 heures après la création de la tâche, avec nettoyage planifié qui peut être retardé ; les données minimales de tâche sont ensuite conservées 48 heures pour les quotas et la protection contre les doublons. Datalab applique ses propres règles de conservation. Supprimer un document local ou se déconnecter ne supprime pas immédiatement les copies cloud. Les documents ne servent pas au ciblage publicitaire. Les publicités sont désactivées à la livraison ; Pro les supprime. Les achats passent par Samsung, et la configuration publique vient de GitHub sans transmettre de documents. Contact : chennoufo11@gmail.com.
